import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import axios from 'axios'; const API_URL = 'http://localhost:5000/api'; function Dashboard() { const [stats, setStats] = useState({ scheduler: {}, memory: {}, vfs: {} }); useEffect(() => { fetchStats(); }, []); const fetchStats = async () => { try { const [schedulerRes, memoryRes, vfsRes] = await Promise.all([ axios.get(`${API_URL}/scheduler/stats`), axios.get(`${API_URL}/memory/stats`), axios.get(`${API_URL}/vfs/stats`) ]); setStats({ scheduler: schedulerRes.data, memory: memoryRes.data, vfs: vfsRes.data }); } catch (error) { console.error('Error fetching stats:', error); } }; return (

🖥️ CoreX OS Dashboard

{/* Main Grid Layout */}
{/* Top Stats Cards - Row 1 */}
⚡ CPU Utilization
{stats.scheduler.cpu_utilization || 0}%
💾 Memory Hit Ratio
{stats.memory.hit_ratio ? stats.memory.hit_ratio.toFixed(1) : 0}%
📁 Storage Used
{stats.vfs.used_blocks || 0} / {stats.vfs.total_blocks || 0}
{/* CPU Scheduler - Row 2, Column 1 */}

⚙️ CPU Scheduler

Algorithm
{stats.scheduler.algorithm || 'N/A'}
Avg Wait
{stats.scheduler.avg_waiting_time || 0} ms
Avg TAT
{stats.scheduler.avg_turnaround_time || 0} ms
Avg Response
{stats.scheduler.avg_response_time || 0} ms
📊 Info: Manages process execution using FCFS, SJF, Round Robin, and Priority algorithms for optimal CPU utilization.
{/* Memory Management - Row 2, Column 2 */}

🧠 Memory Management

Algorithm
{stats.memory.algorithm || 'N/A'}
Page Faults
{stats.memory.page_faults || 0}
Page Hits
{stats.memory.page_hits || 0}
Frames Used
{stats.memory.used_frames || 0} / {stats.memory.total_frames || 0}
💡 Info: Implements FIFO, LRU, and Optimal page replacement algorithms with {stats.memory.total_frames || 256} frames for efficient memory usage.
{/* File System Status - Row 2-3, Column 3 */}

📁 File System Status

Total Inodes
{stats.vfs.total_inodes || 0}
Used Inodes
{stats.vfs.used_inodes || 0}
Total Blocks
{stats.vfs.total_blocks || 0}
Block Size
{stats.vfs.block_size || 0}B
🗂️ Info: Virtual File System with hierarchical directory structure supporting file creation, deletion, and navigation operations.
); } export default Dashboard;
